captions_meta.hook: Only 38% of Filipinos trust most news most of the time. 📰
lines: Reuters Institute Digital News Report 2025, trust in news:
Low trust means audiences look for proof.
Releases with real data, named spokespeople and sources stand out.
captions_meta.li_hook:
Trust in news in the Philippines sits at 38%, according to the Reuters Institute Digital News Report 2025.
That changes how brands should communicate.
li_body: For context, the same survey puts Thailand at 55%, Singapore at 45%, Australia at 43%, Malaysia at 37% and Indonesia at 36%.
In a lower-trust environment, claims are discounted and proof is rewarded. For brand announcements, that means:
li_points: Lead with verifiable data, not adjectives.
Name a real spokesperson who can be contacted.
Cite your sources and link to them.
Get published by established media, then share that coverage on social.
captions_meta.li_close: How does your team build credibility into announcements?
